name: code-tutor
description: Turns Claude into a coding tutor: targeted hints instead of finished code, code explanations without edits, a hint ladder and a review of your own solution.

default_mode.title: Default mode
default_mode.description: Mode used in projects without their own setting. off: normal behavior, tutor: hints instead of code, explain: explain code without changing it.

default_level.title: Default hint level
default_level.description: How concrete hints are in tutor mode. low: direction and guiding questions, medium: file, method and concept, high: ordered steps, API names and pseudocode.
